summary: Completed testing of new property fields (is_tama, has_agent_fee, agent_fee_price, agent_fee_currency, currency, furniture_option, condition, square_meters, amenities, porches, sukkah_compatible) and Property Condition dropdown. Backend API 100% working. Frontend form submission had a bug with empty string handling - FIXED.

integration_issues.issue: Empty strings sent for optional numeric fields (square_meters, agent_fee_price, monthly_price, nightly_price) caused 422 validation error
integration_issues.status: FIXED - Added cleanedForm conversion in handleAddProperty

passed_tests: POST /api/properties accepts all new fields: is_tama, has_agent_fee, agent_fee_price, agent_fee_currency, currency, furniture_option, condition, square_meters, amenities (list), bedrooms/bathrooms/floor as float
GET /api/properties/{id} returns all stored fields correctly
Property Condition dropdown exists with 3 options: Renovated, Partially Renovated, Good Condition

All form fields present: title, description, rental_type, property_type, bedrooms, bathrooms, floor, area, address, price with currency selector, porches (with conditional sukkah/sqm), elevator (with conditional shabbat), tama checkbox, agent fee checkbox with amount/currency, furniture option, amenities checkboxes, property condition dropdown
Form submission from frontend creates property in backend successfully (after fix)

Conditional rendering works: Sukkah checkbox appears when Porches > 0, Shabbat Elevator appears when Has Elevator is checked, Agent Fee input appears when Agent Fee checkbox is checked, Furniture Option dropdown only appears for long-term rental type
seed_data_creation: Test properties created and cleaned up during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new property fields (is_tama, has_agent_fee, agent_fee_price, agent_fee_currency, currency, furniture_option, condition, square_meters, amenities, porches, sukkah_compatible) are working correctly in both backend and frontend. Property Condition dropdown has 3 options: renovated, partially_renovated, good. Frontend form submission bug was fixed by converting empty strings to null for optional numeric fields.

fix_applied.description: Added cleanedForm object in handleAddProperty to convert empty strings to null for optional numeric fields (square_meters, agent_fee_price, monthly_price, nightly_price) before sending to API
